profile_text.body:
NVIDIA, founded in 1993 and headquartered in Santa Clara, California, is a public company that reported revenue of $215,938,000,000 for the fiscal year ending January 25, 2026. The company describes itself as building agentic AI with multimodal foundation models through its Nemotron family, which the company characterizes as "a family of highly efficient, multimodal, open AI models built for long-running, self-evolving agents" designed for complex reasoning tasks in graduate-level science, advanced mathematics, and visual understanding.

NVIDIA's primary AI products in this domain are the Nemotron enterprise LLM family and NVIDIA NIM, an inference microservices platform for deploying foundation models. According to the company's site, Nemotron models are available as optimized NIM microservices and excel in reasoning, multimodal vision, retrieval-augmented generation, speech, and safety applications. The company also offers NVIDIA Nemotron Speech models for automatic speech recognition, text-to-speech, and neural machine translation, plus Nemotron Retriever models for document understanding and embeddings. NVIDIA makes these models available through open-source licensing under the NVIDIA Open Model License while also offering them as enterprise deployments through NVIDIA AI Enterprise, requiring users to access resources at build.nvidia.com.

The company publishes model weights, training datasets, and training techniques to support developer community use, and provides tools including NVIDIA Dynamo, TensorRT-LLM, and NIM for production-scale deployment alongside popular open-source libraries. NVIDIA operates under California jurisdiction with 208 cases tracked by the site.
